site_name: Granville Centre, 80 Granville Road, London, NW6 5RA
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details pursuant to condition 15 (external lighting) of Variation of Conditions reference 22/2876 dated 20/12/2023 Variation of conditions 18 (Overheating risk assessment) 19 (Highway works) 20 (External lighting) 33 (BREEAM) to allow rewording of conditions for construction works, of Full Planning Permission reference 19/2378 dated 23 January, 2020, for Partial demolition of existing structures on site including part of the Granville building, refurbishment of the Granville and Carlton Centres and construction of 3 buildings ranging from one to eight storeys in height, to facilitate the provision of a mixed use development comprising 18 self-contained flats at part 1st - 8th floors and community facilities, offices and workshops at lower ground, ground and part first floors. Works include creation of play areas for the children's centre, nursery and school; additional community and event workspaces, outdoor amenity areas, secure cycle and refuse storage.
